butterslip_owner.text: Welcome to the Butter Slip Cafe. We are named for the slip outside, one of Kilkenny's narrow medieval lanes. Mind your elbows.
If someone says they are 'giving out' in Kilkenny, they are scolding you, not donating. I am mostly donating soup.

then.text: A second cup? That is how a visit turns into an afternoon. Go on with you.

else.text: Here, a cup of tea for the road. It is the Irish way to keep warm and keep talking.
